findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "v1" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_moda_contact, check_facebook_group_link, check_listing_words, search_moda_help, get_moda_news, send_moda_report · Private data: check_moda_contact · Public sink: check_moda_contact, check_facebook_group_link, check_listing_words, fix_my_listing, send_moda_report · Destructive: fix_my_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_moda_contact, check_facebook_group_link, check_listing_words, search_moda_help, get_moda_news, send_moda_report · Private data: check_moda_contact · Public sink: check_moda_contact, check_facebook_group_link, check_listing_words, fix_my_listing, send_moda_report · Destructive: fix_my_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
